briefdescription.para: Shut down a DDR device's power domain.

detaileddescription.para: If the device has a power parent, sends it a power-down event and clears the device's NODE_IDLE_DONE flag after a successful transition. Any failure is reported through the internal debug-error logger.

parameterdescription.para: DDR device whose power parent and flags are updated.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when no power parent exists or power-down succeeds; otherwise the status returned by the power parent's event handler.
